scope: ET6 native in-flight successor delivery guard
defect: Successor polling and response processing did not recheck evidence resynchronization state; an in-flight response could be queued before the next controller tick handled resync.
repair: Require running controller, no resync, no Emergency Stop and no pending evidence at both poll capture and response processing, retaining existing exact envelope/plan checks.

verification.coverage: Readiness predicate tested across every controller state and each blocking flag; existing rolling and interruption fixtures pass.

limitations: Predicate and controller tests do not simulate the complete asynchronous HTTP runtime.
A response blocked after leasing is not replayed. Capacity under transient evidence backpressure and safe bounded retention of received responses remain to be tested.
No deployed native or packaged EXE acceptance is established; reconnect recovery remains unqualified.
